verdict.rationale: A tax agency could plausibly run a transmitter or bulk-filer program, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing channels: the MyDOR portal, a file-upload option inside the web return flow, Express file, and an automated phone line. Nothing documents a system-to-system channel, system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs, or an enrollment path, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
